market_question: Will PSG win the 2025–26 Champions League?
reasoning: PSG's true probability of winning the 2025–26 Champions League is far lower than the market's 58.5%. No single team in modern Champions League history has ever been a >50% pre-season favorite given the depth of elite competition. PSG has never won the tournament and frequently falls short in the knockout rounds. A more realistic probability is around 15–20%, making the 'No' side significantly underpriced.
evidence_points: No team has held >40% implied probability to win the Champions League before a season in the past two decades; 58.5% is historically unprecedented.
PSG's best UCL finish was runner-up in 2020, but they have been eliminated before the semi-finals in most seasons.
The tournament features many world-class squads (Real Madrid, Manchester City, Bayern Munich, etc.), diluting any single club's win probability.
